name: Senri Kanzaki
source:
Undoubtedly one of the strangest members of the group, Senri is a dedicated student with a passion for engineering, centered around robotics. Her self-assurance and strong beliefs often lead to arguments and conflict, exacerbated by her rather noticeable lack of interpersonal skills. Senri is forever curious, and delights in learning.

She may seem difficult, but her motives are essentially good, and ultimately she just wants what she thinks is best for everyone - whether they like it or not. Her suspicions behind the motives of the Human Reignition Project have driven her to join the group, if only to see if she was right all along.
